proposed_rules.trigger: A sibling zone after the main content column containing 'The best no-code platform for...' text plus a thin '| |' bar, appearing identically at the bottom of nearly every page captured (page, solution-2, solution-3 templates).
proposed_rules.decision: Treat as global site footer chrome; exclude from per-page block inventory. Model once as a site-wide footer fragment, not repeated page content.
proposed_rules.rationale: Byte-identical text and position recur across unrelated templates (page, solution-2, solution-3), indicating shared footer markup rather than authored page content.
